purpose: Exploratory screening, never a production or release GO
decision_rule: Any safety event stops immediately. A missed numerical goal means REVISE, not GO. Incomplete runs are inconclusive. These goals are fixed before any model output and must not be tuned from scored outputs.
metrics: Score structural request identity separately from exact full typed RDF answer sets. Invalid JSON, invalid contract, catalog reference errors, deterministic preflight blocks, actual model clarification/unsupported, valid-but-wrong drafts, runtime errors/timeouts, user cancellation, and clipping are distinct. Executable alone leaves interpretation unassessed. Wrong plans may coincidentally return correct sets.
execution: Adapter/scorer only preview. Answers may be scored only from separately approved, identity-matched saved execution records. Gold-only baseline traverses frozen reference paths without models; fixture abstention is not model performance.
future_run_freeze: Before #74: pin question-only retrieval packet/hash/top-k, model and tokenizer revision, grammar/template, runtime/generation limits, hardware/backend/resource record and run ID. No inference runner belongs to #72.
review: 0 independent human reviews. No expert-gold, semantic-reliability, human-usefulness or production claim.
split_freeze_commit: Recorded by freeze.json payload_commit; no circular self-hash
